theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.hecke_root_product {K : Type u_3} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
q * -q⁻¹ = -1

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.hecke_quadratic_factor {K : Type u_3} [Field K] (q x : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
(x - q) * (x + q⁻¹) = x ^ 2 - (q - q⁻¹) * x - 1

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.seminormal_radicand_nonneg {K : Type u_4} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] (h u : K) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hu2 : u ^ 2 ≠ 1) (hb : |h / (u - u⁻¹)| ≤ 1) :
0 ≤ h / (1 - (u ^ 2)⁻¹) * (h / (1 - u ^ 2)) + 1

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.seminormal_radicand {K : Type u_3} [Field K] (h u : K) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hu2 : u ^ 2 ≠ 1) :
h / (1 - (u ^ 2)⁻¹) * (h / (1 - u ^ 2)) + 1 = 1 - (h / (u - u⁻¹)) ^ 2

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.seminormal_diag_product {K : Type u_3} [Field K] (h u : K) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hu2 : u ^ 2 ≠ 1) :
h / (1 - (u ^ 2)⁻¹) * (h / (1 - u ^ 2)) = -(h / (u - u⁻¹)) ^ 2

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.cum_eq_zero_of_additive_split {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (L : Finset ι → R) (A B : Finset ι) (hAB : Disjoint A B) (h0 : L ∅ = 0) (hadd : ∀ S ⊆ A ∪ B, L S = L (S ∩ A) + L (S ∩ B)) (S : Finset ι) :
S ⊆ A ∪ B → (S ∩ A).Nonempty → (S ∩ B).Nonempty → cum L S = 0

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.filter_powerset_not_subset_subset {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] (S A B : Finset ι) (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
{T ∈ S.powerset | ¬T ⊆ A ∧ T ⊆ B} = (S ∩ B).powerset.erase ∅

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.filter_powerset_subset {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] (S A : Finset ι) :
{T ∈ S.powerset | T ⊆ A} = (S ∩ A).powerset

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.cum_eq_sizeCum {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (L : Finset ι → R) (f : ℕ → R) (hL : ∀ (S : Finset ι), L S = f S.card) (S : Finset ι) :
cum L S = sizeCum f S.card

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.sum_powerset_erase_apply_card {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (g : ℕ → R) (S : Finset ι) :
∑ T ∈ S.powerset.erase S, g T.card = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range S.card, ↑(S.card.choose j) * g j

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.sizeCum_zero_one {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (f : ℕ → R) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (h1 : f 1 = 0) :
sizeCum f 0 = 0 ∧ sizeCum f 1 = 0

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.sizeCum_eq {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (f : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) :
sizeCum f k = f k - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ↑(k.choose j) * sizeCum f j

noncomputable def QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.sizeCum {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (f : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) :
R

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.sum_powerset_cum {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (L : Finset ι → R) (S : Finset ι) :
∑ T ∈ S.powerset, cum L T = L S

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.cum_empty {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (L : Finset ι → R) :
cum L ∅ = L ∅

theorem QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.cum_eq {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (L : Finset ι → R) (S : Finset ι) :
cum L S = L S - ∑ T ∈ S.powerset.erase S, cum L T

noncomputable def QOU.Mass.SubsetCumulantRecursion.cum {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (L : Finset ι → R) (S : Finset ι) :
R
